review.unweighted_operator: P and W and unitary F and positive-row selection are contractions; amplitude errors at most whole-vector epsilon_l2. DC and RMS epsilon_l2/sqrt(N). Tapered RMS has same debit only when normalized by sqrt(N).
review.margin: Observed strict amplitude margin>2alpha proves unique true discrete-bin maximum among declared selected bins; no continuum frequency or sub-bin guarantee.
review.centroid: Nonnegative per-bin frequency/power bounds and strictly positive lower total power give conservative quotient enclosure; zero lower denominator => HOLD.
review.power_convention: For declared P_j=d_j|FFT(WPv)_j|^2/(N sumw2), amplitude operator is diag(sqrt(d_j/sumw2)) R F W P. Safe norm L<=sqrt(2/sumw2)*max|w|. One-sided Nyquist weight1, interior2.
review.computed_debit: alpha_total=L*epsilon_vector+eta_computation; eta must independently include window, FFT and normalization departures. No validated finite FFT eta supplied.
review.per_sample_conversion: If uniform per-sample epsilon_sample is simultaneous on common grid, epsilon_vector<=sqrt(N)*epsilon_sample; no independence required.
